description: Check documents and AI output against written policy. DSAIL turns a written policy, like a compliance manual, filed rating rules, insurance policy wording or a release standard, into a ruleset and records the rule behind every result. Use it for policy compliance, eligibility, rating and claims checks. It applies the rules a policy already states; it does not decide who may act or who signs off.
displayName: DSAIL: Rules Engine for Written Policy
name: dsail
